\begin{tikzpicture}[on grid=false,node distance=0.8cm]
  % Narrower than the DRLD's hand-drawn maps, which are scaled to the line width anyway: the item
  % boxes keep little side padding and the recipe boxes lose most of tcolorbox's, so a map with

  \tikzset{every node/.append style={inner xsep=2pt}}
  \tcbset{boxsep=0.5mm, left=1mm, right=1mm}
  % tcolorbox sizes an hbox after its body alone, so the recipe name is padded to the widest raw
  % tag of the title (IFU_WCU_OFF_RAW is wider than metis_ifu_rsrf). The lengths are allocated once
  % per document, whichever map comes first.
  \ifdefined\assomapwidth\else\newlength{\assomapwidth}\newlength{\assomaptagwidth}\fi

  \matrix (recipes) [column sep=0.05cm, row sep=1cm]{

    \node [above] (detlingain_raw){%
      \settowidth{\assomapwidth}{\REC{metis_det_lingain}}%
      \settowidth{\assomaptagwidth}{\RAW{DETLIN_2RG_RAW}}\ifdim\assomaptagwidth>\assomapwidth \assomapwidth=\assomaptagwidth \fi%

    }; &[4mm]
    \node [above] (detdark_raw){%

      \settowidth{\assomaptagwidth}{\RAW{LM_WCU_OFF_RAW}}\ifdim\assomaptagwidth>\assomapwidth \assomapwidth=\assomaptagwidth \fi%

  %% AIT / monthly calibrations to the left, daily calibrations and science to the right: a vertical

  \node [fit=(lmadcslitloss_raw)(lmadcslitloss_gainmap2rg)(lmadcslitloss_linearity2rg)(lmadcslitloss_persistencemap)(lmadcslitloss_masterdark2rg)(lmadcslitloss_masterlmlssrsrf)(lmadcslitloss_lmlsstrace)(lmadcslitloss_lasertab)(lmadcslitloss_lmadcslitloss)(lmadcslitloss_lmlssdistsol)(lmadcslitloss_lmlsswaveguess), inner sep=0pt] (sep_left) {};
  \node [fit=(detdark_raw)(detdark_gainmap2rg)(detdark_linearity2rg)(detdark_persistencemap)(detdark_masterdark2rg)(detdark_masterlmlssrsrf)(detdark_lmlsstrace)(detdark_lasertab)(detdark_lmadcslitloss)(detdark_lmlssdistsol)(detdark_lmlsswaveguess), inner sep=0pt] (sep_right) {};
  \draw [thick, dashed] ($(sep_left.north east)!0.5!(sep_right.north west) + (0,5mm)$) -- ($(sep_left.south east)!0.5!(sep_right.south west) - (0,5mm)$);

  \draw [match] (detlingain_gainmap2rg) -- (lmadcslitloss_gainmap2rg);
  \draw [match] (lmadcslitloss_gainmap2rg) -- (detdark_gainmap2rg);

  \draw [match] (lmlssrsrf_persistencemap) -- (lmlsstrace_persistencemap);

  \draw [match] (lmadcslitloss_masterdark2rg) -- (detdark_masterdark2rg);

  \draw [match] (lmlssrsrf_masterdark2rg) -- (lmlsstrace_masterdark2rg);

  \draw [match] (ext_lasertab) -- (lmlsswave_lasertab);

  %% Legend

    column 2/.style={anchor=base west}]
